help: make rpus.co serve the publish tree: copy data/output/site/ into the ext/mnt/site clone, commit there, push - a dry run unless --apply, because it writes outside the repo and the push is what the world sees

args.name: --apply
args.help: perform the copy, commit and push - without it, what would change is only reported

git -C ext/mnt/site push: WRITES what rpus.co serves (--apply only; refused loudly under YOGA_NO_SEND)
